title: How to Build an AI Startup
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: A decade earlier, building an AI startup was incredibly hard.

In the New Way, tasks that were previously very hard (e.g. text summarization) are now much easier with minimal finetuning and out-of-the-box LLMs. You can get pretty far by finetuning your prompts, no coding r
